name: Celestine Mwangi-Olofsson
description: Celestine Mwangi-Olofsson is regarded as the founding legend of independent Gravball in Meridian 88, a Kenyan-Swedish midfielder who played sixteen seasons for the Saltwall Covenant FC without ever accepting corporate sponsorship, retiring in 2204 with a record 847 independent-league goals and a reputation for a playmaking style so geometrically precise that analysts still use her 2188 championship season as the baseline for teaching unaugmented spatial cognition. She played with minimal chrome — a single proprioceptive balance implant installed after a 2191 knee injury, the minimum permitted by league rules — and was loudly contemptuous of full-chrome competitors her entire career.
story_hooks: Now in her sixties, Mwangi-Olofsson discovers that the Saltwall Covenant FC's historical records — including her own match data — are being systematically purchased and archived by an unknown Tier 4 entity, and she wants to know why.

A teenage Shelf Gravball prodigy is being aggressively recruited by HelixCorp and secretly asks Mwangi-Olofsson for advice; the choice the kid makes will define the next twenty years of independent league viability.
The proprioceptive implant installed in 2191 is a model that was quietly recalled in 2205 due to long-term neural degradation — and no one told the retired athletes who still have them.
